menu.title: Dearly Kept
menu.subtitle: Small gifts. Familiar faces.
menu.remove-hint: Remove this gift's note. The item stays in your backpack.
menu.empty-body: Friends and family sometimes send little gifts in the mail. Collect one and its note will appear here while you carry it.
menu.confirm-body: This removes the keepsake note from this stack. Your items stay in your backpack. This cannot be undone.
menu.removed: Note removed. Your gift is still in your backpack.
menu.help: Up/Down: Browse  |  Delete / X: Remove note  |  Esc / B: Close
menu.help-compact: Up/Down: Browse | Del/X: Note | Esc/B: Close
